description: Source code for web configuration bus interface, handling RBUS communication, event subscription, and signaling between components.

methods.name: rbusInit
methods.description: Initializes RBUS handle with component name based on process name.

methods.name: isWebCfgRbusEnabled
methods.description: Checks and enables RBUS if not already enabled.

methods.name: subscribeSubdocForceReset
methods.description: Subscribes to the sub-document force reset event via RBUS.

methods.name: subdocForceReset_callbk_rbus
methods.description: Callback for handling sub-document force reset RBUS event.

methods.name: multiComp_callbk_rbus
methods.description: Handles RBUS events for broadcast, master, and slave components.

methods.name: eventSubHandlerWbFramework
methods.description: Handles subscription and unsubscription events for RBUS components.

methods.name: event_subscribe_bcast
methods.description: Thread to subscribe to broadcast events from master component.

methods.name: eventRegisterSlave
methods.description: Registers slave component to receive data from master via RBUS.

methods.name: eventRegisterMaster
methods.description: Registers master component to send data to slave via RBUS.

methods.name: sendDataToEvent
methods.description: Sends data via RBUS or CCSP signals to other components.

methods.name: EventRegister
methods.description: Registers RBUS or CCSP events for master/slave communication.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromEvent
methods.description: Unsubscribes from RBUS or CCSP events.

methods.name: UnregisterFromEvent
methods.description: Unregisters data elements or events for specific component.

methods.name: subscribeToEvent
methods.description: Subscribes to RBUS or CCSP events.

methods.name: sendWebConfigSignal
methods.description: Sends web configuration signals via RBUS or CCSP.
